issues: Hero CTA label is 'Watch the 20-second demo' while closing CTA is 'Try the 20-second demo' (spec explicitly lists only the closing final CTA as 'Try the 20-second demo', so this is acceptable; noted for awareness).

critical_code_review_comments: HeroVisual.jsx: cancelIdleCallback/clearTimeout cleanup uses `(window.cancelIdleCallback || clearTimeout)(id)`; when the browser lacks requestIdleCallback the id is a setTimeout handle but on browsers that have cancelIdleCallback the id may be an idle-callback id — currently fine because the two branches align, but the ternary pattern is fragile and could silently fail if polyfills change.

API calls on landing are GET-only: /api/demo/scene, /api/demo/points (?colors=true), /api/attempts/<id>/review — zero POSTs. No horizontal overflow at 360/375/768. Six safeguards present.
